name: read_bitmap_byte_via_a3
description: Returns the byte at a bitmap position computed from a horizontal word and a row, using a shift and the row stride. It uses a different base register from the other bitmap lookups.

name: read_bitmap_byte_second_base
description: Returns the byte at a bitmap position computed from a horizontal word and a row, using a shift and the row stride. It takes its base from the second address register.

name: advance_capped_counter_pair
description: Sets a flag to 1 and increments a counter. Once that counter passes 16 it is clamped to 16, a second counter is incremented up to a maximum of 99, and the input register is returned unchanged.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:665E
name: decrement_counter_or_init_state
description: If a counter is zero, sets a state variable to 7 with a set of initial parameters unless it is already 7. Otherwise it decrements the counter and sets a flag to 1.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:66BA
name: reset_state_to_seven
description: Clears a counter and sets a state variable to 7. It also sets two parameters to 7 and 100 and a third to minus 160, then stores a value derived from a base variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:66F2
name: find_matching_table_entry
description: Reads a status code from a called routine, and unless it is 5 searches a table of four-word records for one whose key matches the current position. On a match it sets a flag and stores coordinates and a value derived from that record.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:67A4
name: read_two_bits_reset_state
description: Calls the status reader twice and combines the results with a bitwise OR. When both are zero it sets a state variable to 3 and clears another, then returns the combined value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:67DA
name: reset_state_unless_status_six
description: Reads a status code and, if it is not 6, reads a second one. If the second is also not 6 it sets a state variable to 3 and clears another.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:680A
name: update_input_state_machine
description: Advances a small state machine by reading status words from a called routine and moves the state between values 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5. It clears or resets a counter on some transitions and returns the state value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:691A
name: combine_two_status_reads
description: Reads two status values from a called routine and returns their bitwise OR. A comparison that can never hold is part of the code, so the first read is the one that is used on the other path.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6940
name: check_sequence_of_status_bits
description: Reads status values from a called routine in turn, stopping early when a bit is clear. The values read are discarded and the routine returns once the checks fail.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:698A
name: return_shifted_value_if_both
description: Reads two status values from a called routine. If both have their lowest bit set it returns a saved register shifted right by four bits, otherwise it returns the second value read.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:69CE
name: reset_record_and_clamp_size
description: Clears the fields of a record, sets a global to 4 and resets the record pointer. It then halves a size field, clamps it against a limit and sets two more fields from constants when the status reads require it.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6A70
name: find_and_activate_nearby_record
description: Searches a list of records for one close to a reference position and in a matching direction, marks it active and stores its offset from the reference. It swaps that record with the last record of the list, and falls back to a second list with a different record size when nothing matches.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6C74
name: finish_pending_move_record
description: When a flag is set and a record is active, clears that record and stores its final offsets. Otherwise it stores a starting value, sets a mode bit and places a position value sixteen units back from the current horizontal position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6D10
name: blit_marked_sprite_records
description: Counts a delay down and then either probes the tile cells around the current position or, if a flag is set, clears it and blits each marked entry of a table of three-word records. It waits on the blitter busy status for every blit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6DAE
name: claim_record_and_update_state
description: Searches a table of six-byte records for the one matching a given byte, claims it by setting its used bit and storing two values, and blits its tile to the screen. It then reads a byte from the source and sets a state code, storing the current position for one special value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6F06
name: blit_marked_records_and_clear
description: Walks a table of three-word records and, for each entry whose mark bit is set, clears its first two words, toggles the mark and blits its tile while waiting on the blitter.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:6FB4
name: check_position_match_event
description: Returns early when a flag is set. Otherwise it compares the masked horizontal and vertical positions with two stored values, allowing one tile of tolerance, and sets an event code when both match.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:7028
name: classify_status_and_choose_target
description: Reads a status code and, when one bit is clear, picks a horizontal target based on a second bit and a vertical limit, reading further status codes as needed. Otherwise it records a mode from 1 to 3 according to the code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:70B4
name: run_frame_motion_state_machine
description: Runs the per-frame state machine that counts down timers, moves a position and mode variable between states, and reads status codes to decide transitions. It writes the new position back into the active record and calls many other routines.

name: clear_sixteen_word_table_halves

name: clear_sixteen_word_halves_b

name: clear_sixteen_word_halves_c

name: clear_sixteen_word_halves_d
description: Copies the first sixteen words of a global table onto themselves, which leaves them unchanged, and then zeroes the following sixteen words.

name: read_little_endian_word
description: Reads two consecutive bytes from a pointer and returns them combined as a 16-bit little-endian value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:7B38
name: build_level_tile_tables
description: Expands packed level data into 256-entry tile tables, remaps the tile codes and reads a list of per-object records with positions and sizes. It writes the background colour register and stores the derived map dimensions.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8684
name: index_positions_into_tile_cells
description: Walks a list of four-byte entries and, for each entry whose position is valid and inside the map, stores a reference to its tile cell and an attribute value. It writes the tile code into that cell.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:87C6
name: write_alternating_row_cells
description: Writes a run of cell values into a buffer, alternating between two sources for the first half of the count and using a third source for the rest. A routine call writes each cell from a base offset.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:88A2
name: update_horizontal_scroll_offset
description: Adjusts a horizontal delta from two status checks and clamps it. It then computes a target from a stored base and applies correction steps through routine calls, returning the amount moved.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8B6E
name: update_status_flag_bytes
description: Clears five state bytes, then sets them from two status reads. One flag is set when a status code is non-zero, and two more are set when each sampled value is positive or negative.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8C34
name: accelerate_position_delta_clamped
description: Adjusts a position delta by a shift amount taken from a counter, decreasing or increasing it according to a mode flag. The result is clamped to the limit passed in.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8CB0
name: step_delta_by_eight_clamped
description: Adds or subtracts eight from a position delta depending on a mode flag and clamps the result to the limit passed in.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8D14
name: advance_value_clamped_to_limit
description: Adds sixteen to a stored value and caps it at the limit passed as the argument.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8D3A
name: decay_delta_toward_zero
description: Moves a variable toward zero by a shift amount chosen from a counter, clamping it at zero so it never passes the origin.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8DA8
name: compute_sprite_frame_coordinates
description: Looks up a 20-byte record by index, derives screen coordinates and bounds from the current position and the record's size, and redraws the sprite through a routine only when its frame index differs from the stored one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:8F8A
name: copy_record_tables_forward
description: Copies every entry of a table of 92-byte records and a table of 24-byte records into their backup tables, byte by byte.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:900E
name: restore_record_tables_from_backup
description: Copies the backup tables of 92-byte and 24-byte records back into the working tables, clears a counter, and sets the stored position on records of types 27 and 28 when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9050
name: restore_record_table_reset_specials
description: Copies a backup table of 24-byte records back into the working table, clears a counter, and sets the stored position on records of types 27 and 28 when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:908E
name: reset_special_record_positions
description: Clears a counter and sets the stored position fields of records of types 27 and 28 when a flag is set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:90F8
name: initialise_level_state
description: Sets up a new level: writes two digit characters into text buffers, sets display limits from a lookup, clears the sprite and event tables and runs a series of setup routines. It also stores the starting position and an initial count.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9376
name: reset_level_state_for_retry
description: Writes a digit into a text buffer, sets the starting position, clears the sprite and event tables and resets the status variables, without rebuilding the whole level.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9496
name: compute_scroll_bounds_from_position
description: When no scroll target is pending, derives horizontal and vertical targets from the current position clamped to the level bounds. Otherwise it copies the pending targets, then clears them and stores their low nibbles.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9640
name: initialise_interrupt_control
description: Disables all interrupt sources, clears pending requests, and then enables a chosen set of interrupt sources by writing the enable register. It also calls library routines around these writes.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:96BA
name: restore_saved_interrupt_mask
description: Disables all interrupt sources, waits for the blitter to finish, and then writes the saved interrupt enable mask back with its set bit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:970E
name: match_four_byte_key_index
description: Compares four bytes at the given pointer with each five-byte entry of a 16-entry table and stores the matching entry index plus one. A match at the last entry, or no match, stores the value 1000.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:97C8
name: show_menu_entry_and_wait
description: Builds a text line of dashes and four digits, prints it, and waits for a button press. When the selection is unset it prints a different prompt, waits, and sets the selection to 1.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:994C
name: poll_input_codes_until_match
description: Polls a called routine for a set of input codes, looping until one of the expected codes is seen, then calls further routines before returning.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:99D0
name: allocate_and_release_work_block
description: Allocates a 16384-byte memory block through a library call, stores a value derived from the result, and then frees the block again.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9A2E
name: draw_record_centred_at_position
description: Looks up the width and height of a 20-byte record by index, offsets the given position so the record is centred on it, and calls the drawing routine with the record index.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:9A9E
name: run_setup_then_halt_loop
description: When the argument is zero, runs a short setup sequence that includes a blitter wait and a threshold check which may display a message. It then loops forever without returning.

name: load_assets_and_run_game
description: Initialises game constants and loads the music, sound effect and graphics files from disk, showing loading messages, then calls the main play routines. It also reads the disk status port.

name: clamp_scroll_enter_dispatch_loop
description: Fragment decoded from a gap in the code: clamps a horizontal limit, copies the stored position into the current position, clears the state and then jumps into the state dispatch loop.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ABA6
name: reset_all_state_restart_level
description: Fragment decoded from a gap in the code: clamps a horizontal limit, copies the stored position, and then resets a long list of state, count and mode variables before the dispatch loop begins.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ADB0
name: advance_sprite_animation_frame
description: Advances a sprite's frame code by one, remapping several code ranges to fixed frames, then sets its image, size and offset fields from the frame tables.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:AE92
name: load_sprite_kind_parameters
description: Finds the table entry matching the sprite's current code, then copies position, size and timing values from a parameter block into the sprite record. The layout of the copied fields depends on the sprite's kind code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B450
name: stub_return_only_gap
description: Contains only a return instruction; it was decoded from a gap in the code and is not a meaningful routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B4BC
name: resolve_sprite_collision_bounce
description: Searches the sprite list for an entry whose box overlaps the current sprite and, when one is found, changes its kind code and adjusts the vertical positions and velocities of both sprites.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B59E
name: update_sprite_timed_state
description: Updates a sprite's state code from its counter, switching between two states when a limit is reached and clearing the active bit when the timer runs out. It sets a shared mode value while a sprite is in the timed state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B6E4
name: trigger_mode_three_on_overlap
description: When the sprite's active bit is clear and its box overlaps the current position, sets a mode value to 3, loads a counter with 28 and clears another variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B762
name: test_rectangles_overlap
description: Returns 1 when two sprite boxes overlap both horizontally and vertically, and 0 otherwise.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B7B4
name: update_active_sprite_list
description: Walks the list of active sprites, sets or clears a status bit on each from a shared counter, and calls a routine for each entry in its child list. It flips the vertical direction and clears the entry when it fires.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:B8AA
name: update_sprite_physics_table
description: Updates every record of the sprite table: adjusts kind codes for some types, moves each record relative to the current position, tests overlap with the view and the level map, and applies landing, bouncing or hit responses through routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:BEFE
name: add_effect_entry_to_slot
description: When a flag is clear and a status bit is set, places a new entry with a fixed code and two coordinates into the first free slot of a three-slot table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:BF3E
name: cycle_effect_slot_animation
description: For each of the three effect slots, clears a flag, reloads its value from a lookup table and advances its frame code cyclically from 0 to 19, changing it only on every fourth step.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:BFD4
name: move_moving_platform_entries
description: Moves each active entry in a list of 20-word records by a step along one axis, reversing direction when its count reaches a set limit. It also shifts the current position when the entry carries it.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C160
name: copy_active_table_pointer
description: Copies the active table base value into the current table pointer variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C164
name: copy_active_table_pointer_b
description: Copies the active table base value into the current table pointer variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C168
name: copy_active_table_pointer_c
description: Copies the active table base value into the current table pointer variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C17C
name: reset_four_default_longwords
description: Writes fixed default values into four consecutive longword variables, used as their initial settings.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C1A6
name: build_display_register_list
description: Fills a display list buffer with register write pairs taken from scroll and bitplane variables, selecting one of two buffers by a flag. It stores the bitplane address pointers and an end marker.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C35C
name: build_column_strip_table
description: Fills two parallel tables with one entry per column for 176 columns, using a fixed pattern for most columns and a value looked up from a table chosen by the type code for the rest.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C554
name: decode_nibble_palette_rows
description: Repeats sixteen times: unpacks 16-bit colour entries into nibble components, rebiases them, and waits for a frame flag before writing the adjusted entries to the colour table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C760
name: clear_work_buffers
description: Zeroes two large work buffers of 8820 longwords each and a third buffer of 336 longwords.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C7B2
name: setup_then_halt_forever
description: Runs four setup routines, including a DMA control write, and then loops forever without returning.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C866
name: write_fixed_display_list_pairs
description: Writes a fixed set of sixteen-bit value pairs into two copies of a display list at fixed offsets, and sets the final colour entry from a stored word.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:C976
name: clear_fixed_display_list_pairs
description: Writes the value 384 or zero into a fixed set of slots in two display lists, clearing the entries used by the sprite layout.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:CA6E
name: initialise_display_and_tables
description: Allocates the working tables and display buffers by size, fills a 256-entry bit-reversal lookup, sets the display window, fetch, modulo and copper registers, and builds two display lists with colour and sprite entries.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:DBE8
name: lookup_value_in_range_table
description: Scans a table of three-word entries and returns the value of the last entry whose range contains the given number, or 1000 when none matches.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:DC6A
name: map_code_to_frame_field
description: Looks up a code and stores a matching fixed value in a field of the record, then sets a flag bit when the code is one of a set of special values.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:DDBC
name: sum_tile_block_sizes
description: Adds up the size of each tile block in the ranges belonging to the given id, rounding each to whole units, and returns twice the total.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:DECA
name: mark_range_entries_for_id
description: For every range belonging to the given id, sets the matching entries of a flag table to one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:DF66
name: rebuild_active_object_set
description: Clears a set of sixty flags, marks the types used by active objects, and drops any type that would exceed a fixed size budget. It then clears object entries whose types are unmarked and rebuilds the active count.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E188
name: start_timed_state_with_offset
description: Sets a timer to 100, a state value of 200 and a mode value of 3, then sets an offset whose sign depends on the current position. It calls two routines and sets a stage value of 5.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E1DC
name: trigger_record_on_overlap
description: When two timers are zero, tests whether a record overlaps the current position horizontally and vertically. If it does, it clears the record code, sets a state value of 28 and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E27C
name: advance_four_moving_records
description: Advances each of four records by combining its position and step fields, updates a counter when the step is small, and clears the record when a routine reports it has finished.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E33E
name: check_free_slot_available
description: Returns 1 when one of the four entries of the table has a zero code, meaning a free slot is available, and 0 otherwise.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E352
name: scan_slots_for_occupied_entry
description: Steps forward through a slot table counting down a count, and returns 1 when it finds an occupied entry or 0 when no entries are left.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E362
name: initialise_entry_from_position
description: Fills a new entry with a code from a lookup table, a position and a step whose sign is taken from the current position, then resets its count and state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E3B0
name: store_record_code_and_position
description: Writes a record with a code derived from the low 13 bits of a value minus 29, a position pair, and default zero and one fields.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E3CE
name: set_direction_from_relative_position
description: Stores a magnitude from the record, negated when the given horizontal position is left of the current position, into the record's velocity field.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E3E6
name: offset_by_sign_of_velocity
description: Returns the argument minus sixteen, or plus sixteen when the stored velocity is negative.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E3F8
name: set_velocity_toward_target
description: Stores the magnitude of a velocity field, negated when the argument is less than a stored target value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E412
name: update_object_bounce_and_timer
description: Updates an object's movement: when idle it reverses a speed to bounce within a range, and when a timed state is set it counts a field down. When a flag is set it adds a fixed step to a counter or links the object into a list.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E44A
name: update_enemy_chase_state
description: Updates an enemy's facing toward the current position and runs its timers, starting a pursuit or hold step when the position is within a set range. Its return value depends on the branch taken.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E476
name: update_enemy_direction_and_timer
description: Sets an entry's facing from the current position, counts down its delay, and starts a new step when the delay runs out and the entry is in range. It returns the position value it used.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E4BC
name: start_attack_when_close
description: Compares an entry's horizontal position with the current position and, when the distance is within a range taken from its size field, sets its state to 30 and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E4EA
name: tick_entry_delay_and_step
description: Counts down an entry's delay and, while a flag is set, advances its accumulator by four and calls two routines. The delay is cleared afterwards.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E510
name: run_enemy_jump_attack_state
description: Runs a two-stage attack: an idle entry close to the current position starts a counted sequence, and an active entry flips direction and steps through its sub-states. Inactive entries are placed in the pending list until their timer expires.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E556
name: start_timed_approach_state
description: When an entry is active and close enough horizontally to the current position, increments its state, computes a negative count from an accumulating sum and resets its timers before calling a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E59C
name: advance_timed_approach_state
description: While an entry is active, advances a counter-driven state. At state 1 it flips the direction when the count ends and moves to state 2; at state 2 it resets to state 0 once the count passes a limit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E5EE
name: advance_entry_state_two_counter
description: When an entry is in state 2, increments its counter and resets it to state 0 once the counter passes its limit, calling two routines when that happens.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E61E
name: run_enemy_patrol_state_machine
description: Runs a patrol state machine for an enemy: in its idle state it starts a pursuit when the horizontal position is within range, reverses direction at the limit, and returns to idle at the target. Inactive entries are queued in the pending list.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E66E
name: reverse_at_patrol_limit
description: In state 1, reverses the direction of an entry at its patrol limit and advances its state. In state 2 it resets the state to 0 when the counter reaches the target.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E696
name: reset_state_at_target_count
description: Resets an entry's state to 0 when its counter reaches the target value, calling two routines first.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E6AE
name: run_enemy_approach_decision
description: Chooses an enemy's next state from its distance to the current position: it approaches within a range, moves through states 1 to 3 with fixed distance checks, and queues itself in the pending list while inactive. Returns the distance measured.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E704
name: run_enemy_approach_decision_b
description: Chooses an enemy's next state from its distance to the current position, moving through states 1 to 3 with fixed distance checks. It is a variant of the approach decision that returns no value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E732
name: run_enemy_sway_state
description: Updates an enemy's movement by reversing its speed on a flag, computing its distance to the current position, and setting its state to 2 or 3 depending on distance checks.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E796
name: start_attack_in_range
description: When an entry is in state 1 and within a horizontal range of the current position and a vertical range of nine, sets its state to 3 and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E7D4
name: run_enemy_state_by_code
description: Dispatches an enemy update by code: code 2 checks whether the entry is far from its anchor and resets its state, while code 3 runs the approach decision for inactive entries.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E81C
name: run_enemy_approach_code_three
description: When the code is 3, counts the wait for an enemy and turns it toward the current position when a flag is clear, then sets its state to 1 or 2 depending on distance.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E834
name: run_enemy_detect_and_follow
description: Runs an enemy that detects the current position within a range and then follows it: in its idle state it checks distance, and in its following state it turns and moves until it is out of range, calling routines at each change of state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E888
name: update_enemy_turn_on_distance
description: When the code is 1, counts a delay and reverses the entry's horizontal speed when a flag says so, moving it to state 2 when far from the current position. Otherwise it returns the entry to state 0 when its anchor is out of range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E8B4
name: reverse_speed_when_far
description: Clears a delay, reverses the entry's speed when a flag bit is set, and switches its state to 2 when it is far from the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E904
name: reset_entry_state_when_far
description: When an entry is farther than a set distance from its anchor horizontally or vertically, sets its state to 0 and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E946
name: run_enemy_pursuit_state_machine
description: Runs an enemy state machine: an idle entry starts a pursuit when the current position is near, a pursuing entry turns and steps toward the position, and far entries change state. Inactive entries are queued in the pending list and the measured distance is returned.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E996
name: run_enemy_pursuit_state_variant
description: Runs the same pursuit state logic as the value-returning pursuit routine, but returns no value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:E9D6
name: turn_and_switch_when_far
description: Calls a routine to test an entry, reverses its horizontal speed on a flag, and switches its state to 2 when it is more than 640 units from the current position.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EA2A
name: dispatch_entry_state_by_code
description: When the code is 2, checks whether the entry has moved out of range of its anchor and resets its state if so. Otherwise it counts down its wait and sets its state to 1.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EA72
name: start_entry_and_return_value
description: Starts an entry by counting its wait and setting its state to 1 when it is not in a pending state, then returns the result of a routine. When the entry is pending it returns zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EA8E
name: step_entry_back_and_start
description: Calls two routines around a step that subtracts two from a counter, then sets the entry's state to 1 and calls a further routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EAA6
name: run_enemy_chase_and_patrol
description: Runs an enemy with idle, approach, chase and return states. It begins a chase when the current position is near, switches to a return state when it is far, and queues itself in the pending list while inactive.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EAFE
name: run_enemy_chase_variant
description: Runs a state machine that switches between idle and chase states from distances to the current position, setting states 0, 2 or 3 and calling routines on each change.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EB42
name: reset_entry_state_to_idle
description: Calls a routine and then sets the entry's state to 0.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EB4C
name: dispatch_chase_state_by_code
description: When the code is 2, steps the entry's turn and switches it to state 3 when it is far from the current position. Otherwise it checks its anchor distance and resets its state to 0 when it is out of range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EBA6
name: reset_state_outside_anchor_range
description: When an entry is outside a horizontal and vertical range of its anchor, calls two routines and sets its state to 0.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EBEC
name: run_enemy_attack_cycle
description: Runs an enemy cycle in which an idle entry engages when near the current position, a countdown field triggers an attack step that reloads the timer, and the state moves between idle, engaged and recovering. Inactive entries are queued in the pending list and a status value is returned.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EC3C
name: reset_state_gap_fragment
description: Fragment decoded from a gap in the code: calls a routine and sets the entry's state to 0. The normal program flow does not reach it.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EC46
name: dispatch_enemy_attack_state
description: Dispatches an enemy update by code: code 1 steps the entry's turn and attack timer and may start an attack, code 2 checks anchor distance and resets the state, and other codes count down a timer and step the state. Returns the distance used.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ECA2
name: tick_attack_countdown
description: Counts an attack timer down and, when it expires while the entry is close horizontally and vertically to the current position, sets its state to 3, calls two routines and reloads the timer.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ECD8
name: dispatch_entry_code_and_timer
description: Returns a distance when the code is 2 and the entry is in range of its anchor. Otherwise it counts its timer and steps its state, returning the value from a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ED20
name: step_entry_timer_and_restart
description: When a flag bit is set, advances the entry's timer by four, calls routines and sets its state to 1, returning the routine result.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ED42
name: run_entry_movement_sequence
description: Runs a four-phase movement sequence for an entry. Phase 0 records the start position and moves to phase 1, phase 1 counts down a wait, phase 2 moves the entry until it passes a stored position and switches to phase 3, and phase 3 counts a delay back to phase 0.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ED66
name: advance_entry_movement_sequence
description: Advances a movement sequence: phase 1 counts down and moves to phase 2, phase 2 moves the entry past a stored position and switches to phase 3, and the remaining phases count a delay that resets the state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:ED7E
name: advance_entry_counter_or_idle
description: When the code is 2, advances an entry's counter and moves it to state 3 once the counter passes a stored position. Otherwise it counts a timer down and sets the state to 0 when the timer reaches zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EDA8
name: count_down_entry_timer
description: Decrements an entry's timer and sets its state to 0 when the timer reaches zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EDB4
name: run_entry_four_phase_routine
description: Runs a four-phase enemy routine: an idle entry faces the current position and starts a delay when it is close, that delay leads to a phase that counts up to ten, and the last phase counts down before returning to idle. Inactive entries are queued in the pending list.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE10
name: run_three_phase_timer_sequence
description: Advances a timer sequence: phase 1 counts down and moves to phase 2, phase 2 counts up past ten, moves to phase 3 and reloads its count, and the final phase counts down and returns to phase 0 with three routine calls.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE30
name: advance_timer_sequence_late_phases
description: Advances the timer sequence in its later phases only, returning to phase 0 when the countdown finishes.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE5C
name: finish_timer_sequence
description: Counts a timer down and, when it reaches zero, calls three routines and sets the entry's state to 0.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE74
name: run_entry_approach_and_follow
description: Clears a status flag, then starts an approach when an idle entry is near the current position. In the approach state it counts a timer and turns toward the position, switching to a follow state when far, and it resets to idle when out of range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE7E
name: clear_entry_status_flag
description: Clears the upper status bits of an entry's flag word and keeps its low six bits.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:EE86
name: queue_or_count_inactive_entry
description: When an entry's status bits are set, either places it in the pending list or advances its counter, using a fixed value of minus 160 as its starting position. Otherwise it does nothing.
